key.name: enable-frosted-glass
key.description: Whether to render background blur effect under the capsule

key.name: layout-style
key.description: Visual layout of the launcher: 'monolithic' (single integrated capsule) or 'island' (detached icon squircle and search pill)

key.name: blur-radius
key.description: Radius in pixels for background blur effect

key.name: max-results
key.description: Limit of items displayed in the search result list

key.name: show-app-grid
key.summary: Show Spotlight App Grid on empty search
key.description: Whether to display a grid of frequently used apps when query is empty

key.name: enable-apps
key.description: Include installed desktop applications in search results

key.name: enable-windows
key.description: Include currently open desktop windows in search results

key.name: enable-calc
key.description: Perform on-the-fly math calculations in search results

key.name: group-apps-in-menu
key.summary: Group applications in menu by category
key.description: Whether to organize applications under group sections in the menu grid

key.name: groups-version
key.description: Monotonically increasing version counter for app groups synchronization
